text: The Kolmogorov complexity K(x) of a string x is:
choices: the length of the shortest program that outputs x on a universal Turing machine
always equal to the length of x
explanation: K(x) is the shortest-program length reproducing x - an individual, distribution-free measure of information. It is not an entropy of a distribution, and most (not all) strings satisfy K(x) ~ |x|.
